'''Kennedy''' (Japanese: '''クロダ''' ''Kuroda'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG017|Stairway to Devon]]''. He is the assistant to the [[Devon Corporation]]'s President, [[Mr. Stone]]. He notifies Mr. Stone of upcoming appointments and scheduled meetings.

Max first saw Kennedy chasing after Mr. Stone and mistook him for a kidnapper. After the misunderstanding was cleared, Mr. Stone sent Kennedy to escort {{Ash}}, {{an|May}}, and {{an|Brock}} to the Devon Corporation to reunite them with Max. The entire time, Kennedy made little conversation aside from niceties with Ash and {{ashfr}}, though he did inform them about Mr. Stone's son, {{Steven}}. Kennedy keeps a phone with him at all times, and assisted Ash and his friends as they tracked down the {{tc|Team Aqua Grunt}} on the Devon Corporation's roof.
